measurement_and_state_candidates.name: anchored sparse trial-level measurement model plus structural path equations
advantages: uses an explicit sparse loading pattern
can be compared by held-out feature reconstruction
conditions: fix each factor scale and sign
use diagonal or shrinkage residual covariance
measurement_and_state_candidates.falsification: unstable signs/loadings, rank deficiency, poor recovery, or no held-out improvement over proxy baseline

measurement_and_state_candidates.name: predefined standardized V/H/P feature composites with regularized path regression
advantages: appropriate if latent loadings are not identified
measurement_and_state_candidates.falsification: composites fail to reproduce on held-out files or effects reverse across files

measurement_and_state_candidates.name: unconstrained PCA/latent EM
measurement_and_state_candidates.role: not selected as final inferential model
measurement_and_state_candidates.reason: component sign/scale/rotation are arbitrary; PCA initialization does not identify V/H/P meanings

classification_candidates.name: random forest or XGBoost
classification_candidates.role: exploratory only if effective sample/groups support tuning
classification_candidates.reason: higher overfit risk at current 297 matched EEG trials and four files

behavior_candidates.name: cue+task logistic baseline vs cue+task+EEG logistic model
choice/RT DDM with censored omission likelihood
conditions: parameter recovery and sufficient independent groups

preprocessing_decision.ica: not primary with only three scalp leads and no independent EOG; use auditable artifact flags and sensitivity analysis
